summary: Former Forest Service lookout on Shirttail Peak, Shasta County, documented in 1943 and 1947; FFLA lists it gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association list marks it gone; no source we read describes what remains.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Trinity National Forest

events.note: W.H. Williams had been on top of the peak for several months as a forest lookout, per a November 1943 Blue Lake Advocate item.
Mrs. Anna Key was installed for her second year as Forest Service lookout; she also reported fires on private land under state protection.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two 1943 and 1947 newspaper items on one page, the FFLA list, and a Peakbagging row. No build date, removal date or current-site description found; the story leaves those out. A Facebook group post (not cited) says the lookout was built to a 1934 C3-type design per a California lookout report; that claim is unverified and not used. The Peakbagging row lacks the (LO site) label that other removed lookouts carry, so its status there is unclear. The NHLR and FFLOS pages were not reached. Not checked on the ground.
